train_config._description: Training recipe for the BC-ResNet command classifier (2026-09-30), adapted from the wakeword recipe (../../model/train_config.json). Keys starting with '_' are documentation.
train_config._epochs: 60 x 375 steps = 22,500 steps. Measured 2026-09-30 over 300 steps from scratch: training loss 3.1 -> 2.0 on clean clips, 3.2 -> 2.8 with the Pi-like augmentation, 3.2 -> 2.9 with augmentation + SpecAugment: the augmentation makes each example harder, so it needs many more steps than the clean data would.
train_config._spec_augment: Time masks up to 150 ms: shorter than any deciding word (a number, 'Jane', 'up'/'down'), so a mask cannot turn a command into another one; it can hide a syllable.
train_config.selection: mean of owner / public / synthetic command macro accuracy and 1 - unknown false-action rate on validation (argmax)
train_config._selection: Validation only. The owner validation clips are one session of one speaker (13:36-13:55), so the selection is not tuned to speaker2 or to the test session.

loader_config._description: Schema-B run (owner, 2026-10-01): copy of dataloader_config.json with the schema-B clip list (owner + classmates' datasets), the schema-B label map and a `classmates` source group. Everything else unchanged.
loader_config._epoch_draws: An epoch is a fixed number of weighted draws, not a pass over the clips: the sources differ in size by 100x, so a pass would be dominated by the public datasets. 48,000 draws = 375 steps of 128. (First probe, 2026-09-30: 8 epochs x 6,000 draws = 376 steps in total did not learn at all under the full augmentation; a fixed batch of 256 clean clips is memorised in 300 steps, so model and features were fine and the step count was too small.)
loader_config._unknown_share: About 1 in 5 training examples is `unknown` (owner-approved: sample unknown down).
loader_config._command_class_sampling: Each command class is drawn equally often, whatever its clip count (volume_up has 1,201 train clips, text_jane 58).
loader_config._command_source_weights: Within a class, the source group is drawn with these weights, renormalised over the groups the class has (12 classes have no public clips). owner = the owner's own recordings; web = FSC / SLURP / Timers and Such; synthetic = Philippine-accent TTS, cloned FLEURS voices, Piper voices and voice-converted owner recordings. 2026-10-01: + variants = other wordings of each command (synthetic, train-split voices; data/commands_variants_train), 0.2 taken from web/synthetic. Schema-B run: + classmates = Classmate A's voice-cloned Option-B set, SynTTS, Classmate F's VCM temperature clips and the classmates' own recordings (other_speakers); 0.15 taken from synthetic (0.1) and variants (0.05). Many schema-B classes (COLOR_*, TIMER_10S, ...) only have classmate clips: the weights are renormalised over the groups a class has.
loader_config._unknown_source_weights: Within unknown: the owner's unknown prompts, the owner's room recordings, MUSAN noise/music/speech, FLEURS Filipino/English speech, MSWC single words, public-dataset off-list requests, synthetic off-list sentences and silences, and cut-off commands (fragments). Schema-B run: + gsc (Google Speech Commands single words, own group so 100k clips cannot flood `web`) and classmates (SynTTS other commands and wake words, VCM other temperatures, ...).
loader_config._format_alignment: Every real capture starts with the tail of 'Delta', the chime gap and a pause. Public clips and reused unknowns are trimmed speech without it, so the model could learn 'no tail -> public dataset'. Each of them gets a real prefix prepended (train: random; validation/test: fixed per clip), drawn from a bank of TRAIN-split prefixes: owner recordings before the first command word, and synthetic clips' 'Delta' tail + pause.
loader_config._augment: Train only: ../augment_commands.py (wakeword augmentation v4, same for every class; owner recordings never get room echo).
loader_config._owner_extra_background: Added 2026-10-01 after the streaming-gap test (owner commands 100% as clips, 86% -> 45% as the room noise under them gets louder; failures go to unknown). The owner's recordings never got background (they are already as noisy as Pi audio), so owner voice + owner-room noise only ever appeared as `unknown` (reuse_owner). Now half of the owner-recording draws (every class, fragments too) get a second layer of TRAIN-split owner-room audio at its own recorded level -6..+3 dB. Previous config: dataloader_config.before_owner_noise.json.
loader_config._num_workers: Shared server with a high CPU load: 12 workers for one training run.
loader_config._background_talk: Added 2026-10-01 after the Pi A/B TV session (talk show: 70-76% correct; 20 of 35 captures ran to the listener's time limit). Before, background was only mixed over the clip's own length and the rest of the 5 s window was quiet padding, so the model never saw a command with talk continuing to the end of the window. Now 35% of draws (every class alike) get TV/radio from TRAIN-split FLEURS/MUSAN speech (75%) or MUSAN music (25%), 3-18 dB below the clip's speech peak, half through a room response; 60% of those first run on to the full 5 s with their own room sound so the bed plays to the end. Previous config: dataloader_config.before_improve.json.
